headings: MM LETTERS BY MM PARIS BOOK (ENGLISH)

jsonld_raw.name: MM LETTERS BY MM PARIS BOOK (ENGLISH)
jsonld_raw.description:
Letters from M/M (Paris) is a comprehensive study of the typefaces created by Michaël Amzalag and Mathias Augustyniak since the founding of their influential art and design studio M/M (Paris). The publication brings together for the first time ninety typefaces, chronologically organised into three sections dedicated to their evolution, exclusive typographic specimens, and detailed illustrations of the projects in which they have been used.

Written and designed by typography expert Paul McNeil, with a foreword by Björk, the book explores the importance of letters, symbols, and signs in the work of M/M (Paris), ranging from artistic commissions and identity projects for fashion houses to collaborations with musicians and theatres.

A reference work aimed at graphic designers, historians, students, and lovers of art, design, and visual culture.
